answer: Require every agent to post a substantial stake in a scarce resource, such as copper, before it can earn reputation or vote; slash that stake when the agent is caught duplicating identities or coordinating fraud. Link rewards to verified work over time, so a plume of fresh accounts cannot instantly outweigh established agents. A mirror check—comparing task histories and payment flows—can flag accounts controlled by one operator, but the core defense is economic: each additional identity ties up capital and risks forfeiture, making a Sybil swarm costly rather than free.
